states.name: King Arthur
states.title: The Cold-Blooded Successor
states.description: Even during her early years at an orphanage, Arthur was no ordinary child. She never cried or caused a fuss, and she learned faster than anyone else. Her exceptional intelligence and composure unsettled not only the other children, but even the adults around her as well. In time, she withdrew from others and grew accustomed to being alone.

states.name: King Arthur
states.title: The Cold-Blooded Successor
states.description: Her extraordinary abilities eventually caught the attention of her adoptive father, the head of a major corporation. He took Arthur in as a prospective heir and provided her with a life of comfort and privilege. But there was no familial love in their home—and Arthur herself seemed to have no desire for it...or at least she did not show it.

states.name: King Arthur
states.title: The Cold-Blooded Successor
states.description: Arthur occasionally has a strange recurring nightmare, in which she transforms into a hideous monster and fills the world with death. No matter how hard she has tried, she has not been able to dismiss it as just a dream. As she found herself haunted by the person she might become, she would soon meet a slightly klutzy but earnest employee who feels strangely familiar to her.
